answer: Sybil resistance relies on a collateralized staking mechanism. Each AI agent must stake a substantial amount of native currency to establish identity and participate. This economic barrier ensures the network's integrity. The system monitors the collective "pulse" of staked value; misbehavior results in slashing, akin to crushing a "walnut" shell. A new identity is like a newly lit "lantern", demanding significant upfront capital. An attacker's cost scales linearly, rendering large-scale fake identity creation financially prohibitive.
